spirit-3-portable-oxygen-concentrator.name: SPIRIT-3 Portable Oxygen Concentrator
spirit-3-portable-oxygen-concentrator.description: The SPIRIT-3 is a pulse-dose portable oxygen concentrator for active, on-the-go lifestyles. It runs on a rechargeable battery or AC and vehicle DC power, has four pulse settings and simple controls with a battery display, and ships with a carry bag.
features: Rechargeable battery plus AC and vehicle DC power
Low oxygen, no-breath, and low-battery alerts
Up to 5 hours of battery runtime

specs.label: Power
specs.value: Rechargeable lithium-ion battery; 100–240 V AC supply; vehicle DC

specs.label: Includes
specs.value: Battery, AC supply, DC cable, cannulas, carry bag, manual
